The view looks up User by user_id without confirming that the user belongs to the caller's enterprise identity federation domain. Any organization possessing SCIM sync credentials can alter group memberships for users belonging to other enterprise tenants.

corrected_code:
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from django.contrib.auth.models import Group, User

class SCIMUserGroupSyncView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request, user_id):
        # Validate that the target user belongs to the authenticated SCIM client's domain
        target_user = get_object_or_404(User, id=user_id)
        if target_user.profile.federated_domain != request.user.profile.federated_domain:
            raise PermissionDenied("Target user does not belong to your identity domain")

        group_names = request.data.get("groups", [])
        # Only allow syncing groups prefixed with the tenant domain
        domain_prefix = f"{request.user.profile.federated_domain}:"
        sanitized_group_names = [g for g in group_names if g.startswith(domain_prefix)]

        groups = Group.objects.filter(name__in=sanitized_group_names)
        target_user.groups.set(groups)

        return Response({
            "user": target_user.username,
            "groups": [g.name for g in target_user.groups.all()]
        })
